title: Your fitness history belongs to you

sources.title: Bring your fitness history home
sources.intro: Start with the original export ZIP. FitFreed validates it, translates supported records into an independent local library, and leaves the source archive untouched.
sources.localOnly: The ZIP and the history built from it stay on this device. FitFreed does not upload them or ask for your provider credentials.
sources.haveArchiveBody: Choose the original archive supplied by the provider. You can safely import a newer or repeated export later.
sources.needArchiveBody: Follow a concise copy of the last verified official process. The instructions remain available without a network connection.
sources.guideTitle: How to obtain your Polar Flow export
sources.guideIntro: FitFreed documents the official acquisition path so the first step in owning your data does not depend on guesswork.

instructions.sign-in: Sign in on the official Polar account page in your default browser.
instructions.open-download-data: Open the Download your data area in the account menu.
instructions.request-export: Choose Download to ask Polar to prepare the export.
instructions.wait-for-email: Wait for Polar's email confirming that the archive is ready. Preparation time varies.
instructions.download-zip: Use the email link to download the ZIP, keep it unchanged, and return to FitFreed.

constraints.preparation-time-varies: Polar controls preparation and email delivery time; FitFreed cannot see its progress.
constraints.two-week-download-window: Polar says the prepared export remains available to download for two weeks.
constraints.derived-data-excluded: Polar says the export excludes some information derived by its services, including examples such as activity and sleep data. FitFreed can only use records present in the ZIP.

sources.troubleshootingHeading: If the archive does not arrive or import

troubleshooting.email-delivery: Check the address and spam folders associated with the provider account. Requesting or tracing the email remains a provider operation.
troubleshooting.expired-download: If the download window has expired, request a new export from the official account page.
troubleshooting.archive-format: Select the original ZIP. Do not extract, rename its internal files, or create a new ZIP before importing.

sources.externalNotice: Official pages open in your default browser. Their content and availability are controlled by the provider.
sources.providerBoundary: FitFreed never receives your credentials, signs in, requests the export, or downloads it for you.
sources.guideUnavailable: The guide for this source is unavailable. FitFreed will not guess provider instructions.

reports.heading: Turn recorded evidence into something you can use
reports.intro: Start with a question, a comparison, a training session, or a blank page. Combine local evidence with your own interpretation, review the boundary, and export a self-contained HTML report.
reports.empty: No reports have been saved yet. Start with a question or a blank page below.
reports.chooseHeading: What do you want to understand or explain?
reports.chooseBody: Let FitFreed prepare a useful training-history question, or begin with your own structure and add evidence when it helps.
reports.resolving: Resolving the report against the current library…
reports.questionDefaultTitle: How has my recent training changed?
reports.blocksIntro: Order the evidence and interpretation as you want them to appear in the saved report and export.
reports.narrativeHelp: Write what the evidence means to you. FitFreed keeps your words distinct from recorded measurements.
reports.includeHeartRateHelp: Adds average and maximum heart rate when the source recorded them.
reports.heartRateUnavailable: This session has no recorded heart-rate summary.
reports.endpointRedactionHelp: FitFreed removes at least this recorded distance independently from the start and finish. The saved default is 200 m.
reports.zeroRedactionWarning: Zero removes no distance from the recorded start or finish. Use it only when revealing both route endpoints through the shape is safe.
reports.addRouteIntro: Routes stay local. Adding one stores only its opaque reference and your endpoint-redaction choice.

reports.routesFailed: Routes could not be resolved from this library snapshot. Existing report content is unchanged.
reports.noRoutes: This session has no route evidence available for a report.
reports.allRoutesAdded: Every available route is already in this report.

analysis.allAdded: All available comparison views are in this report.
analysis.rangeAttribution: Calculated by FitFreed from {baseline} and {comparison} in the current local library.
analysis.descriptiveOnly: This is a descriptive comparison of recorded data. It does not establish a cause or provide health or training advice.
analysis.unavailable: The comparison evidence is not available from the current local library.
analysis.chartSummary: Baseline and comparison bars with exact values in the table below

updates.heading: Application updates
updates.intro: FitFreed validates signed release information before announcing an update.

trustFailures.downgrade: A release older than the installed version was rejected.

errors.invalid-supported-artifact: This package contains recognized data that FitFreed cannot validate. Keep the original ZIP and report the compatibility problem; no history was changed.
errors.invalid-source-subject-evidence: FitFreed cannot establish which provider account this package belongs to. Choose the original complete export ZIP; no history was changed.
errors.source-subject-confirmation-required: This package has different or changed account evidence. FitFreed will not merge it with the existing history automatically. Keep the ZIP until account separation and recovery are available; existing history was preserved.
errors.invalid-library-correlation-state: FitFreed cannot verify this library's account-correlation state. Do not import again until the library has been preserved and the problem has been investigated.
errors.invalid-zip-container: This is not a supported ZIP container. Choose the original export ZIP without repacking it.
errors.unsafe-archive-member: The package contains an unsafe file layout. Keep the original ZIP and report the compatibility problem; FitFreed did not extract it.
errors.duplicate-archive-member: The package contains duplicate file names and cannot be imported safely. Request a new export or report the compatibility problem.
errors.archive-resource-limit: The package exceeds a safety limit. Keep the original ZIP and report its approximate size so compatibility can be assessed safely.
errors.archive-io-failure: FitFreed could not read the ZIP. Move it to a local readable folder and try again.
errors.database-failure: FitFreed could not update the local library. Restart the application and retry; if it fails again, preserve the library before reporting the problem.
errors.interrupted: The previous import was interrupted and rolled back. Retry the original ZIP; existing history was preserved.
errors.import-already-active: Another import is already active. Cancel it or wait for it to finish before retrying.
errors.import-coordination-failed: FitFreed could not coordinate the import. Restart the application before retrying.
errors.library-unavailable: The local library is unavailable. Restart FitFreed; if the problem persists, preserve the application data before reporting it.
errors.library-query-failed: FitFreed could not read fitness history. Restart the application and try again.
errors.invalid-activity-range: Choose an ordered range inside the available history, up to 366 days.
errors.invalid-activity-comparison: Choose ordered comparison periods inside the available history, up to 366 days each.
errors.invalid-training-range: Choose an ordered training range inside the available history, up to 366 days.
errors.invalid-training-comparison: Choose ordered training comparison periods inside the available history, up to 366 days each.
errors.invalid-training-session-search: Choose an ordered training-session date range and a personal sport name of up to 80 characters.
errors.training-session-search-changed: Your training library changed. Refresh the search and continue from the first page.
errors.training-session-search-failed: FitFreed could not search training sessions. Your history is unchanged; restart the application and try again.
errors.invalid-sport-classification: Choose a supported broad family, enter a sport name of up to 80 characters, or return the sport to unknown.
errors.sport-classification-conflict: This sport classification changed while it was open. Review the current value and try again.
errors.sport-classification-failed: FitFreed could not read or save sport classifications. Your training history and previous classifications are unchanged.
errors.invalid-sleep-range: Choose an ordered sleep range inside the available history, up to 366 nights.
errors.invalid-sleep-comparison: Choose ordered sleep comparison periods inside the available history, up to 366 nights each.
errors.invalid-sleep-reference: That sleep detail is no longer available. Refresh the period and choose the night again.
errors.invalid-recovery-range: Choose an ordered recovery range inside the available history, up to 366 nights.
errors.invalid-recovery-comparison: Choose ordered recovery comparison periods inside the available history, up to 366 nights each.
errors.invalid-recovery-reference: That recovery detail is no longer available. Refresh the period and choose the night again.
errors.invalid-longitudinal-range: Choose an ordered shared period inside the complete available history, up to 366 dates.
errors.invalid-longitudinal-comparison: Choose ordered shared comparison periods inside the complete available history, up to 366 dates each.
errors.invalid-library-home-request: FitFreed could not open that library view because its context was invalid. Return to Home and try again.
errors.invalid-exploration-workspace: That exploration is no longer supported by the current library. Return to Home and choose an available question.
errors.exploration-workspace-query-failed: FitFreed could not restore the previous exploration. Your history is unchanged; return to Home and choose a question again.
errors.exploration-workspace-update-failed: FitFreed could not save the exploration safely. Your history is unchanged; try the question again.
errors.outcome-query-failed: FitFreed could not read the latest import outcome. Restart the application and verify the library before importing again.
errors.source-guide-query-failed: FitFreed could not load the bundled source guide. Restart the application; FitFreed will not guess provider instructions.
errors.official-source-link-failed: FitFreed could not open the official page. The offline instructions remain available; open the provider page directly in your browser if needed.
errors.preference-query-failed: FitFreed could not read the saved application settings. Safe defaults are being used for now; restart the application before changing them.
errors.preference-initialization-failed: FitFreed could not save the initial application settings. Safe defaults will be used for this session; restart the application to try again.
errors.preference-update-failed: FitFreed could not save the application settings. The previous settings have been restored; restart the application before trying again.
errors.invalid-preference-version: These settings belong to an unsupported application version. Restore the defaults before saving them.
errors.invalid-locale: That language is not supported by this FitFreed version. Choose English (US) or Spanish (Spain).
errors.invalid-appearance: That appearance is not supported. Choose System, Light, or Dark.
errors.invalid-content-zoom: Choose a content zoom from 100% through 200%.
errors.desktop-task-failed: A desktop task stopped unexpectedly. Restart FitFreed before retrying the previous action.
errors.desktop-operation-active: FitFreed cannot install an update while another import or update is active. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
errors.desktop-operation-coordination-failed: FitFreed could not reserve the application for this update. Restart FitFreed before trying again.
errors.import-failed: The import could not be completed. Retry once; if it fails again, keep the original ZIP and report the problem.
errors.update-channel-failed: FitFreed could not complete the update check. Your local library was not changed; try again later.
errors.update-state-unavailable: FitFreed could not read or save the local update state. Preserve the application data and restart before retrying.
errors.update-candidate-changed: The available update changed before the preference was saved. Check again before choosing an action.
errors.invalid-update-preference: The update preference was rejected because its version or time was invalid. Check again before choosing an action.
errors.update-installation-not-allowed: This release is not authorized for in-app installation. Check again and follow the displayed recovery guidance.
errors.update-installation-unavailable: FitFreed cannot safely locate the installed application. Install the update manually or move FitFreed into Applications before trying again.
errors.update-package-trust-unavailable: FitFreed could not load the trusted update key. The package was not downloaded or installed.
errors.update-package-authorization-invalid: The update authorization is no longer valid. Check for updates again before installing.
errors.update-native-installer-failed: FitFreed could not install the verified update. Automatic recovery is protecting the current application and library; reopen FitFreed if it does not restart.
errors.update-download-unavailable: FitFreed could not download the update package. The current application and library were not changed; try again later.
errors.update-package-untrusted: The downloaded update package did not match its signed release information and was rejected. The current application and library were not changed.
errors.update-watchdog-failed: FitFreed could not start the independent update recovery monitor. The current application was not replaced; restart before trying again.
errors.update-recovery-failed: FitFreed could not prepare or advance safe update recovery. Preserve the application data and reinstall manually before retrying.
errors.update-recovery-confirmation-failed: FitFreed could not confirm the updated application and library. Keep the application open while automatic recovery completes.
errors.update-recovery-outcome-failed: FitFreed could not finish or acknowledge update recovery safely. Preserve the application data and restart before trying another update.
errors.invalid-report-definition: The report definition is not valid. Review its title, interpretation, and source session.
errors.report-not-found: That report no longer exists in the local library. Reload the report list.
errors.report-definition-conflict: This report changed while it was open. Reload it before saving again.
errors.report-source-changed: The source history changed after this report was resolved. Reopen it before exporting.
errors.report-evidence-unavailable: The session used by this report is no longer available in the local library.
errors.report-definition-query-failed: FitFreed could not read saved reports. Your library is unchanged; try reloading.
errors.report-definition-update-failed: FitFreed could not save the report. The previous definition is unchanged.
errors.report-export-cancelled: The report export was cancelled. No partial file was left behind.
errors.report-export-failed: FitFreed could not write the complete report. Choose another local destination and try again.
errors.report-export-active: Another report export is already active. Cancel it or wait for it to finish.
errors.report-export-state-unavailable: FitFreed could not coordinate the report export. Restart the application before trying again.
errors.unexpected: FitFreed encountered an unexpected local error. Restart the application before retrying.
